item.title: How to get the Zora Tunic in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Once you get the Zora Tunic in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, you'll be ready to explore the waters of Hyrule. Before you obtain this tunic, the only way to explore underwater is by diving, and even if you have the Golden Scale , Link always has to come up for air. However, after you get the tunic — and a pair of special boots — you'll be able to freely walk under the water. Besides, you must have the tunic to progress the story and complete the Water Temple .

item.title: Reps to probe rising human trafficking, trafficking networks
item.description: By Gift ChapiOdekina, Abuja The House of Representatives has resolved to investigate the rising incidence of human trafficking in Nigeria, mandating its Committees on Human Rights, Interior and Police Affairs to probe the activities of trafficking syndicates and assess the effectiveness of existing measures to combat the crime. The resolution followed the adoption of a motion sponsored by Rep. Dominic Okafor, titled, “Need to Investigate the Alarming Increase in Human Trafficking in Nigeria”, at Wednesday’s plenary. The lawmakers expressed concern over the growing threat posed by human trafficking, particularly to women, children and other vulnerable groups. The House noted that human trafficking remained a grave violation of human rights and dignity, involving the recruitment, transportation, transfer, harbouring or receipt of persons through force, coercion, deception, abuse of vulnerability or other prohibited means for the purpose of exploitation. It observed that victims were increasingly subjected to commercial sexual exploitation, forced labour, domestic servitude, forced begging, organ harvesting and other forms of degrading abuse. The lawmakers attributed the growing vulnerability of Nigerians to trafficking to poverty, unemployment, insecurity, displacement, irregular migration and the activities of organised criminal networks. They further noted that many victims were lured through false promises of employment, education, marriage and opportunities abroad, only to end up in exploitative conditions characterised by physical abuse, psychological trauma and, in some cases, death. The House also expressed concern that trafficking networks operated across state and international borders, exploiting porous borders, inadequate public awareness, weak coordination among relevant agencies and difficulties in identifying and prosecuting offenders. While acknowledging the efforts of the National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons (NAPTIP), the Nigeria Police Force, the Nigeria Immigration Service and other relevant institutions, the lawmakers stressed the need to strengthen their operational capacity, funding, intelligence-sharing and victim-support mechanisms. The House recalled the provisions of the Trafficking in Persons (Prohibition) Enforcement and Administration Act, 2015, and other relevant legislation aimed at preventing trafficking, prosecuting offenders and protecting victims. Consequently, the lawmakers urged the Federal Government to intensify nationwide efforts to combat human trafficking through effective enforcement of existing laws, intelligence-led investigations and prosecution of traffickers and their collaborators. They also called for improved victim identification, rescue, rehabilitation, psychosocial support, legal assistance and reintegration programmes, particularly for women, children and other vulnerable persons. The House further urged the government to address the underlying factors exposing Nigerians

item.content:encoded: By Gift ChapiOdekina, Abuja The House of Representatives has resolved to investigate the rising incidence of human trafficking in Nigeria, mandating its Committees on Human Rights, Interior and Police Affairs to probe the activities of trafficking syndicates and assess the effectiveness of existing measures to combat the crime. The resolution followed the adoption of a motion sponsored by Rep. Dominic Okafor, titled, “Need to Investigate the Alarming Increase in Human Trafficking in Nigeria”, at Wednesday’s plenary. The lawmakers expressed concern over the growing threat posed by human trafficking, particularly to women, children and other vulnerable groups. The House noted that human trafficking remained a grave violation of human rights and dignity, involving the recruitment, transportation, transfer, harbouring or receipt of persons through force, coercion, deception, abuse of vulnerability or other prohibited means for the purpose of exploitation. It observed that victims were increasingly subjected to commercial sexual exploitation, forced labour, domestic servitude, forced begging, organ harvesting and other forms of degrading abuse. The lawmakers attributed the growing vulnerability of Nigerians to trafficking to poverty, unemployment, insecurity, displacement, irregular migration and the activities of organised criminal networks. They further noted that many victims were lured through false promises of employment, education, marriage and opportunities abroad, only to end up in exploitative conditions characterised by physical abuse, psychological trauma and, in some cases, death. The House also expressed concern that trafficking networks operated across state and international borders, exploiting porous borders, inadequate public awareness, weak coordination among relevant agencies and difficulties in identifying and prosecuting offenders. While acknowledging the efforts of the National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons (NAPTIP), the Nigeria Police Force, the Nigeria Immigration Service and other relevant institutions, the lawmakers stressed the need to strengthen their operational capacity, funding, intelligence-sharing and victim-support mechanisms. The House recalled the provisions of the Trafficking in Persons (Prohibition) Enforcement and Administration Act, 2015, and other relevant legislation aimed at preventing trafficking, prosecuting offenders and protecting victims. Consequently, the lawmakers urged the Federal Government to intensify nationwide efforts to combat human trafficking through effective enforcement of existing laws, intelligence-led investigations and prosecution of traffickers and their collaborators. They also called for improved victim identification, rescue, rehabilitation, psychosocial support, legal assistance and reintegration programmes, particularly for women, children and other vulnerable persons. The House further urged the government to address the underlying factors exposing Nigerians to trafficking, including poverty, unemployment, limited access to education and the exploitation of displaced persons. NAPTIP and other security and law enforcement agencies were also urged to strengthen surveillance, intelligence-sharing and coordinated operations against trafficking networks, particularly those operating across state and international borders. The lawmakers called on the Federal Ministry of Education, relevant state ministries, local government authorities, civil society organisations and community leaders to intensify public enlightenment campaigns on traffickers’ tactics and the dangers of deceptive recruitment and irregular migration. The House subsequently mandated its Committees on Human Rights, Interior and Police Affairs to investigate the scale and patterns of human trafficking in Nigeria, examine the activities of trafficking syndicates and assess the adequacy of existing enforcement measures. The committees are also expected to identify challenges confronting agencies responsible for combating the crime and report their findings to the House within four weeks for further legislative action. item.title: Astros reportedly pick next manager as announcement nears
item.description: General Manager Randy Flores and owner Jim Crane of the Houston Astros answer questions from the media at an introductory press conference after Flores signed a contract with the Houston Astros at Daikin Park on November 02, 2026 in Houston, Texas. (Houston Astros/Getty Images) After parting ways with Joe Espada, the Houston Astros appear to be close to naming their next manager, with an announcement potentially coming as soon as today. Multiple reports indicate the team has settled on a candidate to take over the dugout, though it has not officially announced the decision. According to KHOU Baseball analyst Jeremy Booth, the newly hired general manager Randy Flores has made his decision on the team's next manager. The shortlist of candidates, which includes former St. Louis Cardinals slugger Albert Pujols, former Astros catcher Brad Ausmus, and former Astros third baseman Morgan Ensberg, will be notified shortly after the contracts are officially signed. Hearing the #Astros have selected their next manager and should notify candidates shortly after they dot I's and cross T's. I'd imagine they announce after that's done rather than have a repeat of the previous situation. As always with this organization, things can change at any moment. But, with Randy in charge you can already feel the change with how things are led. #Astros @KHOU - Jeremy Booth (@_JeremyBooth) November 10, 2026 Houston sports radio host Lance Zierlein said on X that John Granato, host of The Bench on ESPN 97.5 Houston, announced on his morning show that sources have confirmed former Astros catcher Brad Ausmus has been selected as the team's next manager. On our show just now, @johngranato just announced that sources have confided that Brad Ausmus will be the Astros next manager. https://t.co/PVYfEMtjA3 - Lance Zierlein (@LanceZierlein) November 11, 2026 At Tuesday's General Managers Meeting in Las Vegas, Flores said he and the organization hope to make a decision soon, indicating an announcement could come by the end of the week. "My hope is I get back to Houston at the end of this week, hopefully finalize our manager decision and spend the next week in bunker-down mode filling out our Major League staff and the order of operations of tackling our team and roster construction," Flores said. The Astros are reportedly close to naming a new manager. (Photo by Michaela Schumacher/MLB Photos via Getty Images) (Michaela Schumacher/MLB Photos via Getty Images) Astros owner Jim Crane , senior advisor to ownership and baseball operations Jeff Bagwell, and the Astros' two assistant general managers Charles Cook and Gavin Dickey all participated in the interview process, according to Flores. Pujols reportedly interviewed last Thursday in Houston, and Ausmus had previously interviewed for the vacant general manager position. Texas Rangers bench coach Luis Urueta has also interviewed for the job. Flores, a former relief pitcher for the Cardinals, was a teammate of Pujols from 2004 to 2008.

"I want to be open-minded to whatever personality and profile that person is," Flores said on Tuesday. "That's what I want to do." item.title: New Report Offers NY Mets Second Chance at the Mason Miller Trade They Let Get Away Last Year
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect A new report opens the door, just a crack, for the New York Mets to again pursue a trade for superstar closer Mason Miller this offseason. With a lockout looming on Dec. 1, there is a belief around MLB that teams will look to be more aggressive than normal at this week’s general manager meetings to get deals done before payroll guidelines change in the next collective bargaining agreement. You can certainly count the Mets among that group. Last year, Mets decision-makers reportedly spoke with their counterparts from the San Diego Padres about a variety of trade ideas. The rumors suggested closer Mason Miller was a part of those discussions. Obviously, a deal never happened, and the New York front office surely regrets it after the 28-year-old had an outstanding 2026 season. Posting a 1.67 ERA, 38 saves, and 129 strikeouts to 26 walks. Well, the opportunity to acquire him may be possible this month. In a new report, USA Today’s Bob Nightengale floated the idea that Padres GM AJ Preller might consider moving the All-Star this offseason to improve the roster. While the idea would seem ludicrous, the MLB insider notes San Diego has little wiggle room to make moves because Manny Machado, Fernando Tatis, and Xander Bogaerts are owed $721 million and “they each have no-trade clauses.” It means if the Padres want to add to the roster or even their farm system, they might need to move some of the few valuable trade chips they have. What could a Mason Miller trade cost the New York Mets this time around? Sep 30, 2026; San Diego, California, USA; San Diego Padres pitcher Mason Miller (22) reacts after the game against the Chicago Cubs during game two of the Wildcard round for the 2026 MLB Playoffs at Petco Park. Mandatory Credit: Denis Poroy-Imagn Images Miller would be a huge addition for the Mets and bring further security to their bullpen after they traded a handful of relievers before last season’s deadline. Furthermore, there have been rumblings off and on in recent years that the two-time All-Star could be a candidate to make the transition to being a starter. New York had success doing that with Clay Holmes two years ago. If they feel Miller can also make the move, it would give them an interesting option for their rotation who is still under arbitration control for three more years . But the Padres won’t give him away. So what could a trade cost the Mets? Nightengale notes that the Padres will be searching for affordable pitching this offseason because they could lose Michael King, Nick Pivetta, and Adrian Morejon in free agency this offseason. New York could offer young arms with upside like Zach Thornton and Jonah Tong in a potential deal. Furthermore, top-10 pitching prospects Jonathan Santucci and Jack Wenninger might interest San Diego as part of a trade package. If the Padres are looking for changes in left field or at DH, Mark Vientos and Brett Baty could be a part of a trade because they do offer versatility

item.title: Hamilton and Leclerc Clashed Again in Brazil? Here’s What They Actually Said
item.description: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc played down a brief on-track battle in the F1 São Paulo GP, amid recent tensions between the Ferrari teammates. It was only for a brief moment, but both Ferrari ’s Hamilton and Leclerc crossed paths at the F1 São Paulo GP at Interlagos when the Brit started from the back, and the Monegasque was in the midfield. Hamilton made a storming start from the back of the grid and passed Leclerc on Lap 1. However, his tire started to degrade, which allowed Leclerc to get on his tail soon. The Monegasque caught up with him and passed him with ease. Hamilton, Leclerc on the São Paulo GP Battle “I don’t really remember it, but yeah, I think there was a moment where we were close with one another, and yep, it was good,” said Hamilton to the media after the F1 São Paulo GP. At the same time, Leclerc responded: “Yeah, Lewis was much faster than me, so at that time there was no point for me to fight.” Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc. Image Credit: Scuderia Ferrari Hamilton Says Things Are Sorted and They Move On In terms of results, the Grand Prix wasn’t as good for Ferrari, with Leclerc ending up eighth and Hamilton ninth. The Monegasque finished seventh, but a post-race penalty after contact with Liam Lawson dropped him to eighth. It followed a weekend of talks and discussions involving the two F1 drivers and also team boss Frederic Vasseur . As things stand, things seem sorted for now. Hamilton talked about a good discussion on Saturday, and that they squashed things down after a healthy one-on-one discussion. “Yes, everything’s good,” said Hamilton. “Fred brought us together, and Fred was great in the meeting, and then he let me and Charles just give our points, and we both had a really good open discussion, and it’s all good, and we just move on.”

item.title: Memorial Park in Houston opens splash pad for LPGA major winner's leap
item.description: Nelly Korda won the 2026 Chevron Championship and jumped into a makeshift pool on the side of the 18th green at Memorial Park in Houston. The next winner of the LPGA major will get to jump into an actual pond. Golf course architect Tom Doak returned to help redo the 18th hole by adding a pond down the right side of the green. It enables the winner to maintain the tradition of the major — which was played for some 50 years at Rancho Mirage in California — by jumping into the water. It’s not Poppie’s Pond , but it will have to do. The 18th hole opened for public play over the weekend. Memorial Park also hosts the Houston Open held two weeks before the Masters. Gary Woodland won that event in April in dramatic fashion, capturing his first title in since his 2019 U.S. Open win at Pebble Beach. That triumph came weeks after Woodland revealed he was battling symptoms from PTSD after having a lesion removed from his brain. The Annika 2026: Round 1 tee times, groupings, and how to watch The LPGA’s penultimate event starts Thursday morning in Florida. Here’s when Nelly Korda, Charley Hull and other stars are set to tee off. Golf Channel Staff , Golf Channel Staff ,

item.title: 2027: Why Atiku won’t win Adamawa – Shettima
item.description: ….Sets 1.2m votes target for Ondo APC By Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA: President Bola Tinubu has questioned the capacity of former vice president and presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress ADC, Atiku Abubakar to win the 2027 presidential election, saying the former customs chief cannot command consensus even in his home state of Adamawa. The president also queried Peter Obi’s credentials, saying the ability to import cheap South African wines doesn’t make one a guru in economics. Tinubu spoke on Wednesday at the All Progressives Congress APC Presidential Campaign Rally in Ondo State, where he was represented by his vice, Kashim Shettima. The president also set a target of 1.2 million votes for the party in the state. “Our political opponents can conduct political rallies on Facebook and Instagram, but for somebody who cannot gain a consensus at the home front, Atiku Abubakar is from Adamawa State. He has been unable to achieve consensus even in his own Adamawa State. “Of all the five governors that have ever ruled Adamawa in the current dispensation, from Mr Boni Haruna to Murtala Nyako, to James Bala Ngilari, to Senator Mohammed Bindow Jibrilla, to Right Honourable Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri, none of these governors and former governors are in alignment with Atiku Abubakar. And right now, he has three gubernatorial candidates in Adamawa State.. How he is going to unite and drive the nation?”, he asked. Shettima also took on Mr Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress NDC, asking how many former Anambra State governors were with him. “Is Chris Ngige here with him? The answer is no. Is Willie Obiano with him? The answer is no. Is my friend Charles Chukwuma Soludo with him? The answer is no.” He said Obi’s economic credentials were overstated. “The ability to import cheap South African wines doesn’t make one a guru in economics.” Turning to Ondo, Shettima said the state had rallied behind the President. “There is a universal elite consensus backing the President here in Ondo,” he said, naming former Governor Olusegun Mimiko among those aligned with the APC. On the target, he said: “You have registered voters of 2.116 million, we hope that on the 16th of January next year, we hope that the minimum votes we expect from Ondo is 1.2 million votes out of the 1.8 million who have collected their PVCs.” Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa had earlier promised the President “a minimum of one million votes”. He said: “Ondo State stands by you. You have given us more than enough reason to elect you.” The Director General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari, said that figure was too modest. “This one million votes said by Governor, as the DG of the Asiwaju Presidential Campaign Committee, is still small,” he said. He told the gathering: “We are not looking for Asiwaju to win by a margin. We are looking for Asiwaju to get millions of votes that will give the margin for the presidency.” The National Chairman

Tinubu spoke on Wednesday at the All Progressives Congress APC Presidential Campaign Rally in Ondo State, where he was represented by his vice, Kashim Shettima. He has been unable to achieve consensus even in his own Adamawa State. “Of all the five governors that have ever ruled Adamawa in the current dispensation, from Mr Boni Haruna to Murtala Nyako, to James Bala Ngilari, to Senator Mohammed Bindow Jibrilla, to Right Honourable Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri, none of these governors and former governors are in alignment with Atiku Abubakar. And right now, he has three gubernatorial candidates in Adamawa State.. How he is going to unite and drive the nation?”, he asked. Shettima also took on Mr Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress NDC, asking how many former Anambra State governors were with him. “Is Chris Ngige here with him? The answer is no. Is Willie Obiano with him? The answer is no. Is my friend Charles Chukwuma Soludo with him? The answer is no.” He said Obi’s economic credentials were overstated. “The ability to import cheap South African wines doesn’t make one a guru in economics.” Turning to Ondo, Shettima said the state had rallied behind the President. “There is a universal elite consensus backing the President here in Ondo,” he said, naming former Governor Olusegun Mimiko among those aligned with the APC. On the target, he said: “You have registered voters of 2.116 million, we hope that on the 16th of January next year, we hope that the minimum votes we expect from Ondo is 1.2 million votes out of the 1.8 million who have collected their PVCs.” Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa had earlier promised the President “a minimum of one million votes”. He said: “Ondo State stands by you. You have given us more than enough reason to elect you.” The Director General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari, said that figure was too modest. “This one million votes said by Governor, as the DG of the Asiwaju Presidential Campaign Committee, is still small,” he said. He told the gathering: “We are not looking for Asiwaju to win by a margin. We are looking for Asiwaju to get millions of votes that will give the margin for the presidency.” The National Chairman of the APC, Nentawe Yilwatda, said 18 candidates had been presented by 18 political parties ahead of the 16 January presidential election. “Among those 18 candidates, who has the wisdom of experience, wisdom of exposure, wisdom of preparation and wisdom of purpose?” he asked. Yilwatda said Tinubu had met that test. “He has confronted the economic challenges of Nigeria, and he has stabilised the economy. He came when more than 31 states could not pay salaries. Today, all of them can pay salaries.” The Governor of Imo State, Senator Hope Uzodimma, said the uncollected Permanent Voter Cards (PVCs) were a threat to the target. “Your PVCs are still lying at the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) offices, very close to one million yet to be collected. The question is, without your PVC, how will you support President Bola Ahmed Tinubu? You must come out en masse, drop all grievances, be enthusiastic, and vote massively for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu”, he urged. The post 2027: Why Atiku won’t win Adamawa – Shettima appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Withheld Osun LG fund: National public sector union body backs Osun strike
item.description: *Warns FG of total shutdown By Victor Ahiuma-Young The Umbrella body for public sector union in the country, the Joint National Public Service Negotiating Council, JNPSNC, Trade Union Side, has thrown its weight behind the three-day warning strike declared by the Osun State Council of the Nigeria Labour Congress, NLC, over the continued withholding of statutory allocations meant for local government areas in the state by the Federal Government. The national leadership of the council described the industrial action as justified, warning that the prolonged withholding of local government funds, which it said had lasted for about 21 months, had inflicted severe economic hardship on local government workers and their dependants. It called on the Federal Government to immediately release the outstanding allocations to prevent an escalation of the industrial dispute. The national body also cautioned that the continued withholding of the funds could undermine grassroots administration and deepen the economic difficulties confronting workers across Osun State, stressing that urgent intervention was necessary to avert a total shutdown. In a statement by the National Secretary of JNPSNC, Gbenga Olowoyo, on behalf of the national leadership, the council said: “The National leadership of Joint National Public Service Negotiating Council JNPSNC (Trade Union Side), under the Chairmanship of Comrade Benjamin Anto Uyanto mni, has thrown its weight behind the current three days strike called by the Osun State Council of the Nigeria Labour Congress NLC over the continued withheld of the Local government fund by the Federal Government. “The JNPSNC reviewed all the circumstances surrounding the reason for the solidarity strike called by the Osun State Council of NLC, which was premised on the urgent need to release the withheld statutory allocation due to local government areas in the state since February 2025, that is now about 21 months of withholding the fund (from February 2025 to November 2026) and considered it as very justifiable. “The National leadership of JNPSNC considered the continued withheld of the Osun State local government fund by the Federal Government is not only excessive use of political power but also reckless without conscience, on account that the far reaching negative implications on the economic fortunes of the local government administration on one hand and the economic subjugation on the local government workers and their dependants on the hand is better imagined than experienced. “Consequent upon the cry of the entire workers in Osun State, it is very desirable for the Federal Government and all concerned to release the fund without further delay in order to allow Osun State local government workers and their dependants to have economic breath. “The National leadership of JNPSNC regretted that under democratic administration the Federal Government and its agencies responsible for the withheld allocations could descend so low to the exten

In a statement by the National Secretary of JNPSNC, Gbenga Olowoyo, on behalf of the national leadership, the council said: “The National leadership of Joint National Public Service Negotiating Council JNPSNC (Trade Union Side), under the Chairmanship of Comrade Benjamin Anto Uyanto mni, has thrown its weight behind the current three days strike called by the Osun State Council of the Nigeria Labour Congress NLC over the continued withheld of the Local government fund by the Federal Government. “The JNPSNC reviewed all the circumstances surrounding the reason for the solidarity strike called by the Osun State Council of NLC, which was premised on the urgent need to release the withheld statutory allocation due to local government areas in the state since February 2025, that is now about 21 months of withholding the fund (from February 2025 to November 2026) and considered it as very justifiable. “The National leadership of JNPSNC considered the continued withheld of the Osun State local government fund by the Federal Government is not only excessive use of political power but also reckless without conscience, on account that the far reaching negative implications on the economic fortunes of the local government administration on one hand and the economic subjugation on the local government workers and their dependants on the hand is better imagined than experienced. “Consequent upon the cry of the entire workers in Osun State, it is very desirable for the Federal Government and all concerned to release the fund without further delay in order to allow Osun State local government workers and their dependants to have economic breath. “The National leadership of JNPSNC regretted that under democratic administration the Federal Government and its agencies responsible for the withheld allocations could descend so low to the extent of using Federal power to undermine the effective administration of local government in Osun State, which is the closest to the people in the grassroots and the essence of democracy itself in the real sense of it. “Flowing from the above, the Federal Government should be sensitive and responsive enough to listen to the cry of Osun State workers and their dependants and release the withheld allocations funds to Osun State local government which is about 21 months now (i.e. from February 2025 to November 2026) without further delay. “The National leadership of JNPSNC commended the State Chairman NLC, Dr Christopher Arapasopo, as well as TUC, JPSNC and the entire leadership of organised Labour in the State for providing responsible and well coordinated leadership direction during this crucial period in the lives of Osun State Local government workers. “From the look of things and the economic death sentence the local government workers in Osun State Council are passing through, the three-day warning strike may dovetail to total strike or protest by Osun State workers against the Federal item.title: O'Sullivan loses 4-0 to Murphy at Champion of Champions
item.description: O'Sullivan won the last of his seven world titles in 2022 [Getty Images] Seven-time world champion Ronnie O'Sullivan suffered a 4-0 defeat by Shaun Murphy at the Champion of Champions tournament in Leicester. O'Sullivan, who has been struggling for form, was playing for the first time since losing to Ka Wai Cheung at the Northern Ireland Open last month. The 50-year-old found himself 2-0 down against Murphy, who knocked in a 68 in the second frame. Murphy made a 41 break to take the next frame before taking a tense fourth frame 61-42 to secure victory and a spot in the last eight. He will play the winner of the other Group Three match between world champion Wu Yize and Chang Bingyu.

item.title: Why Paul George Flipped Off a 76ers Fan in Return to Philadelphia
item.description: Why Paul George Flipped Off a 76ers Fan in Return to Philadelphia originally appeared on NESN . Add NESN as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Tuesday's battle between the Celtics and 76ers was all about Jaylen Brown's first face-off with Jayson Tatum, but Paul George stole the show in more ways than one. George looked like the best player on the floor, scoring 36 points on 14-of-22 shooting in a comfortable 123-101 win, picking up his Celtics teammates and giving his former fans in Philadelphia a show. The nine-time All-Star also gave 76ers fans something else: a middle finger. Here's how George explained flipping off 76ers fans after he faced his former team on Tuesday night. MORE: Joel Embiid Gives Paul George a Compliment Celtics Fans Might Not Like Why Paul George Flipped Off a 76ers Fan George was seen flipping off a fan after hitting a 3-pointer late in Tuesday's win over the 76ers. Looks like Paul George may have also flipped out a fan (or someone) after that three https://t.co/LecXldKldE — Noa Dalzell 🏀 (@NoaDalzell) November 11, 2026 While no one would be surprised to hear 76ers were taunting George in his first game against his former team, the Celtics star was pretty specific about what exactly happened. "There was a fan being an a—hole," George told CelticsBlog's Noa Dalzell. "Looked me in my eyes, dropped the ball on the ground as if I'm a dog to go fetch or go get it instead of passing the ball to me as a normal fan would do, and so yeah, so then I rolled him a middle finger in return." Asked Paul George what happened here: “There was a fan being an asshole. Dropped the ball on the ground as if like I'm a dog to go fetch or go get it instead of passing the ball to me like a normal fan would do, and so yeah, so then I rolled him a middle finger in return.” https://t.co/W1feMuJzBe — Noa Dalzell 🏀 (@NoaDalzell) November 11, 2026 George might not have had a truly adversarial relationship with 76ers fans during his two seasons in Philadelphia, but even he admitted he didn't play his best with the organization due to his health. "Quite frankly I wasn't healthy to take on the workload that I feel I'm at my best at," George said on Tuesday about his time with the 76ers. Philadelphia fans are undoubtedly happy with their current situation after a hot start to the season, but George got the better of Brown and the Sixers in their first of what could be many meetings to come. More Celtics news: Celtics Have Given Paul George Something He Didn't Expect NBA Expert Changes His Tune on Celtics' Jaylen Brown-Paul George Trade Celtics Reportedly Ignored One Request From Jaylen Brown Before Trading Him Celtics Learn What It Would Take to Acquire Trey Murphy III From the Pelicans

item.title: Here we go again: Can Houston’s 3–5 start spark another playoff run?
item.description: INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA - NOVEMBER 08: Tank Dell #1 of the Houston Texans is unable to catch a pass against Genesis Smith #22 of the Los Angeles Chargers during the second half at SoFi Stadium on November 08, 2026 in Inglewood, California. (Photo by Ryan Sirius Sun/Getty Images) | Getty Images At this exact point in time last season, the Houston Texans were 3-5 coming off a gutsy loss to the 6-2 Denver Broncos. Both seasons have been filled with optimism and frustration, criticism and accolades, clumsy losses and big wins. Texans fans are well aware of what happened last year; they went on a nine game winning streak to close out the season and secure the fifth seed in the AFC Playoffs. The question is, can they do it again? This article will compare the Texans current situation in the AFC South, AFC, and remaining schedule through Week Nine of the NFL season against last year’s team. 2025 AFC South Standings through Week Nine Indianapolis Colts: 7-2 Jacksonville Jaguars: 5-3 Houston Texans: 3-5 Tennessee Titans: 1-8 2026 AFC South Standings through Week Nine Jacksonville Jaguars: 6-2 Houston Texans: 3-5 Indianapolis Colts: 2-7 Tennessee Titans: 1-8 In theory, Houston is in a much better place in the AFC South than last year. While the Colts were predicted to come back to earth, no one would predict they wouldn’t miss the playoffs entirely. Given both the Jags and Colts were playing such good football, winning the division was out of the question. The Jags play the Titans two out of the next three games and also have Dallas (4-5), Washington (2-5-1), and Indianapolis (2-7) on their schedule. That’s five easy victories to get them to 11 wins. Catching Jacksonville may once again not be feasible. They’re currently the most efficient offense and most dominant defense in the league statistically. With Houston three games back from the Jags, it makes more sense to evaluate their place in the AFC. 2025 AFC Playoff Picture after Week 9 Indianapolis Colts (7–2, 6–1 AFC) New England Patriots (7–2, 4–2 AFC) Denver Broncos (7–2, 4–2 AFC) Pittsburgh Steelers (5–3, 4–1 AFC) Buffalo Bills (6–2, 4–1 AFC) Los Angeles Chargers (6–3, 5–1 AFC) Jacksonville Jaguars (5–3, 3–1 AFC) Kansas City Chiefs (5–4, 2–3 AFC) Houston Texans (3–5, 2–2 AFC) Baltimore Ravens (3–5, 2–3 AFC) Cincinnati Bengals (3–6, 3–2 AFC) Las Vegas Raiders (2–6, 2–4 AFC) Cleveland Browns (2–6, 1–4 AFC) Miami Dolphins (2–7, 1–6 AFC) New York Jets (1–7, 1–4 AFC) Tennessee Titans (1–8, 0–7 AFC) 2026 AFC Playoff Picture after Week 9 Buffalo Bills (7-1, 4-1 AFC) Denver Broncos (7-2, 3-1 AFC Jacksonville Jaguars (6-2, 5-2 AFC) Pittsburgh Steelers (6-2, 3-2 AFC) Kansas City Chiefs (6-2, 6-1 AFC) Cincinnati Bengals (6-2, 4-2 AFC) New England Patriots (5-4, 5-1 AFC) Cleveland Browns (5-4, 3-3 AFC) Las Vegas Raiders (4-5, 3-3 AFC) Baltimore Ravens (4-5, 2-4 AFC) Houston Texans (3-5, 3-3 AFC) New York Jets (2-7, 2-4 AFC) Indianapolis Colts (2-7, 1-5 AFC) Miami Dolphins (1-7, 1-4 AFC) Tennessee Titans (1-7, 1-5

(Photo by Ryan Sirius Sun/Getty Images) | Getty Images At this exact point in time last season, the Houston Texans were 3-5 coming off a gutsy loss to the 6-2 Denver Broncos. Both seasons have been filled with optimism and frustration, criticism and accolades, clumsy losses and big wins. Texans fans are well aware of what happened last year; they went on a nine game winning streak to close out the season and secure the fifth seed in the AFC Playoffs. The question is, can they do it again? This article will compare the Texans current situation in the AFC South, AFC, and remaining schedule through Week Nine of the NFL season against last year’s team. 2025 AFC South Standings through Week Nine Indianapolis Colts: 7-2 Jacksonville Jaguars: 5-3 Houston Texans: 3-5 Tennessee Titans: 1-8 2026 AFC South Standings through Week Nine Jacksonville Jaguars: 6-2 Houston Texans: 3-5 Indianapolis Colts: 2-7 Tennessee Titans: 1-8 In theory, Houston is in a much better place in the AFC South than last year. While the Colts were predicted to come back to earth, no one would predict they wouldn’t miss the playoffs entirely. Given both the Jags and Colts were playing such good football, winning the division was out of the question. The Jags play the Titans two out of the next three games and also have Dallas (4-5), Washington (2-5-1), and Indianapolis (2-7) on their schedule. That’s five easy victories to get them to 11 wins. Catching Jacksonville may once again not be feasible. They’re currently the most efficient offense and most dominant defense in the league statistically. With Houston three games back from the Jags, it makes more sense to evaluate their place in the AFC. 2025 AFC Playoff Picture after Week 9 Indianapolis Colts (7–2, 6–1 AFC) New England Patriots (7–2, 4–2 AFC) Denver Broncos (7–2, 4–2 AFC) Pittsburgh Steelers (5–3, 4–1 AFC) Buffalo Bills (6–2, 4–1 AFC) Los Angeles Chargers (6–3, 5–1 AFC) Jacksonville Jaguars (5–3, 3–1 AFC) Kansas City Chiefs (5–4, 2–3 AFC) Houston Texans (3–5, 2–2 AFC) Baltimore Ravens (3–5, 2–3 AFC) Cincinnati Bengals (3–6, 3–2 AFC) Las Vegas Raiders (2–6, 2–4 AFC) Cleveland Browns (2–6, 1–4 AFC) Miami Dolphins (2–7, 1–6 AFC) New York Jets (1–7, 1–4 AFC) Tennessee Titans (1–8, 0–7 AFC) 2026 AFC Playoff Picture after Week 9 Buffalo Bills (7-1, 4-1 AFC) Denver Broncos (7-2, 3-1 AFC Jacksonville Jaguars (6-2, 5-2 AFC) Pittsburgh Steelers (6-2, 3-2 AFC) Kansas City Chiefs (6-2, 6-1 AFC) Cincinnati Bengals (6-2, 4-2 AFC) New England Patriots (5-4, 5-1 AFC) Cleveland Browns (5-4, 3-3 AFC) Las Vegas Raiders (4-5, 3-3 AFC) Baltimore Ravens (4-5, 2-4 AFC) Houston Texans (3-5, 3-3 AFC) New York Jets (2-7, 2-4 AFC) Indianapolis Colts (2-7, 1-5 AFC) Miami Dolphins (1-7, 1-4 AFC) Tennessee Titans (1-7, 1-5 AFC) Los Angeles Chargers (0-8, 0-5 AFC) Visually, the Texans occupy a more precarious position within the conference than they did at this juncture last year.Statistically, however, they remain right on track. The AFC boasts a combined 65 wins through this point in 2026—identical to its total at this exact stage in 2025. Among the current top seven playoff seeds, the numbers mirror each other precisely as well: 43 combined wins for the conference’s current postseason field. Houston faces four remaining games against opponents with superior records. At this time last year, that figure stood at five. That represents one fewer hurdle where the Texans can directly alter the postseason race by knocking off an established contender. While the exact trajectory of the remainder of the season remains unwritten, expecting a repeat rescue via total collapses from the Indianapolis Colts and Kansas City Chiefs is a statistical long shot. Still, the path forward relies entirely on self-execution rather than outside charity. Given the current playoff race mirrors last year’s the magic number to make the playoffs is 11. That means Houston has to go 8-1 to earn a Wild Card spot. With games against the Packers, Jags, and gritty Browns, there’s little room for error. The Texans schedule has eased up a bit with the Ravens, Commanders, and Eagles all struggling thus far. 2025 Houston Texans Remaining Schedule after Week 9 vs Jacksonville Jaguars (5-3) @ Tennessee Titans (1-8) vs Buffalo Bills (6-2) @ Indianapolis Colts (7-2) @ Kansas City Chiefs (5-4) vs Arizona Cardinals vs Las Vegas Raiders (2-6) @ Los Angeles Chargers (6-3) vs Indianapolis Colts (7-2) 2026 Houston Texans Remaining Schedule after Week 9 @ Cleveland Browns (5-4) vs Indianapolis Colts (2-6) vs Baltimore Ravens (4-5) @ Pittsburgh Steelers (6-2) @ Washington Commanders (2-5-1) vs Jacksonville Jaguars (6-2) @ Philadelphia Eagles (2-7) @ Green Bay Packers (6-3) vs Tennessee Titans (1-8) Houston benefitted from playing almost an exclusive slate of AFC opponents down the stretch. Their wining streak helped bring them into the Wild Card race by defeating their rivals for those final few spots. The Texans playoff hopes aren’t in their hands. Just like last year, they need several teams to collapse to make way for their run. A Lamar Jackson-less Ravens team, a Steelers team who hasn’t faced much competition, and a young but unproven Browns team all are prospective teams to fall a part down the stretch. Even then, Houston would still be only eighth in the AFC. To make it to the playoffs for the fourth straight season, they’ll need to get hot at the right time. They’re warming up as we speak.

item.title: Nico Collins, Darren Waller headline Week 10's Regression Files
item.description: Air yards, whether we like it or not — and most fantasy folks definitely do not like it — are a good measure of a pass catcher’s opportunity and the type of passing volume in a given offense. That air yards don’t always translate into real, edible receiving yards is just part of our frustrating little game. We make small bets here and there and hope things break right from week to week and prove our process correct more often than not. It’s not any more complicated than that, even if we desperately want it to be. Over the past few seasons I have used this space to talk mostly about guys with exceptionally high or low touchdown rates. Air yards has mostly been a side issue in the Regression Files. That will change in 2026: I want Regression Files to be your weekly go-to for (freely available) air yards data and what it means for your various fantasy football teams. Thanks to my friend and fellow football analytics nerd Brad Beatson , we have a more organized way of not only tracking air yards data, but a measure of which pass catchers are seeing accurate targets and which guys are not. The latter phenomenon is known in nerdy football circles as Prayer Yards, or inaccurate passes that technically award a bunch of air yards to a given receiver who rarely has a chance of converting those air yards into real yards as the football sails over their head or out of bounds or wherever else. In this space I’m going to look powerfully into total team air yards trends, players seeing plentiful prayer yards, and those who are outperforming their air yards profile and (perhaps) due for the bad kind of regression. Moves to Make Before Week 10 Fantasy Football: Buy Ollie Gordon, sell Drake London Ollie Gordon and Drake London headline the players to buy or sell in fantasy football trades before Week 10 of the NFL season. Alfredo Brown , Total Team Air Yards Below are the teams averaging the most total team air yards per game headed into Week 10. Houston Texans CJ Stroud and the Houston offense, fresh off their bye, poured on the air yards against the Chargers in Week 9. The Texans finished with 470 total team air yards, the most of the week and one of the five highest totals of the 2026 season. They were a cool 11 percent over their expected pass rate; only the Bears were more pass heavy in Week 9. Your question is the same as mine: Where are these oceans of air yards going in the Houston offense? Well, we know where they’re not going. Nico Collins was sixth among Houston pass catchers with a paltry 33 air yards against the Bolts on Sunday. Collins, who’s been reduced to a part-time player since the Texans acquired Marvin Harrison, Jr. from the Cardinals, ran a route on 76 percent of the team’s drop backs and drew a target on just 13 percent of those routes. Bandit.football Tank Dell , with a 55 percent route rate against LA, led the way in air yards by a wide margin. Collins, who’s been reduced to a part-time player since the Texans acquired Marvin Harrison, Jr. from the Cardinals, ran a route on 76 percent of the team’s drop backs and drew a target on just 13 percent of those routes. Bandit.football Tank Dell , with a 55 percent route rate against LA, led the way in air yards by a wide margin. Averaging nearly 17 air yards per target, Dell made the most of his four looks from Stroud and had 104 receiving yards. He was targeted on a heady 41 percent of his pass routes. Things appear to be percolating for the injury-cursed Dell, though his route participation will have to jump if he’s going to be a consistent flex option. The air yards richness of the Houston offense should be a boon for him in any case. Collins’ usage is a problem, maybe a big one if it holds in the coming weeks. Over his past two outings he’s averaging 8.8 air yards per target, way down from the 13.4 air yards per target he saw in the season’s first month. Combine reduced routes with reduced targets and reduced air yards and an explosive WR1 with massive weekly upside turns into something closer to a WR2 without much ceiling at all. Bandit.football At the risk of overstating data from a two-game sample, it sure looks like Dell is boxing out Collins as Houston’s WR1. Dell in Week 9 saw 39 percent of the team’s first read targets. Collins, meanwhile, had a 17.3 percent first-read target rate. Dell, Collins, and Xavier Hutchinson are tied for the most first-read targets over the Texans’ past two games. The good news, perhaps, is that Collins and the Texans in Week 10 take on a Cleveland defense allowing the fourth most team air yards per game (337). You have to keep starting Collins in 12-team leagues, unfortunately. Just know that Dell, for now, is the air yards eater in the air yards-rich Texans offense. Pittsburgh Steelers Mike McCarthy’s offense was raining air yards manna in the first six weeks of the regular season. It was over those six glorious weeks that the Steelers were top-3 in pass rate over expected and top-10 in total team air yards per game (325). Since then, the Steelers have shifted to a run-first offense, going under their expected pass rate in both games before their Week 9 bye. Their 206 air yards per game over those two games ranked 28th overall. The Pittsburgh offense saw both a reduction in pass volume and a cratering average depth of target. If that trend holds up in Week 10 and beyond, it’s going to be exceedingly difficult for Steelers pass catchers to have anything resembling upside without high-variance YAC touchdowns. DK Metcalf, who was born to eat candy and be featured in the Regression Files, dominated air yards over those two run-heavy games, seeing a 53 percent share. A Week 10 date with a pass-funnel Bengals defense could lead to a boost in total air yards for Aaron Rodgers and company. Just be careful how you deploy secondary and tertiary Steelers pass catchers going forward. New York Giants Though the G-people aren’t running a ton of plays — and didn’t need to do much on Sunday to beat the Eagles practice squad — JJ McCarthy continues to push the ball downfield and generate plenty of air yards for New York’s pass catchers. McCarthy, when he wasn’t writhing in pain on the sideline, averaged 10.9 air yards per throw against the Eagles. Since he took over as the Giants’ QB1, the team has the ninth highest average depth of target and the third most total air yards per game (353), behind only our air yards kings (the Packers) and the pointless Cowboys. I know Malik Nabers had a rough one in Week 9. He still led the Giants with 82 air yards — a 33 percent share — while running almost every route. Nabers’ eight first-read targets constituted a 40 percent share. What I’m saying is that he’ll be OK. Isaiah Likely, who ranks third among all tight ends in air yards on the season, will continue cooking in this underrated offensive environment. Even a guy like Malachai Fields — who has a 17 percent air yards share since McCarthy took over — could be interesting against the pass-funnel Washington defense in Week 10. Commanders opponents have been over their expected neutral pass rate in seven of eight games in 2026. Expect the Giants to be next. Below are teams averaging the fewest total team air yards through Week 9. Bandit.football Philadelphia Eagles Here’s what I’ll say about the Eagles’ Joe Milton Experiment (the name of my When In Rome tribute band in college): It was a lot more fun for air yards purposes than the Tanner McKee version of the Philly offense. The Eagles in Week 9 against the G-people totaled 315 air yards, the ninth highest mark of the week. They had averaged 241 total air yards per game with McKee under center. With the tenth highest pass rate over expected of Week 9, Milton’s air yards spike led to 113 air yards for Darius Cooper (a 43 percent share) and 77 for Makai Lemon , who led the Eagles with eight first-read targets to Cooper’s seven. Bandit.football I think Cooper can be somewhat interesting as a high variance option if Milton remains at QB for the Eagles. His 90 percent route rate and 13.8 air yards per target offers more upside than you might think. item.title: Russell Wilson names his new Super Bowl favourites after the NFL trade deadline
item.description: Photo by Noam Galai/Getty Images The 2026 NFL trade deadline passed on November 10 and on the back of it, Russell Wilson is swaying towards the Minnesota Vikings being his Super Bowl favourites. The Vikings were 6-1 before they played the Buffalo Bills on Monday but they fell to a 23-6 defeat, with quarterback Carson Wentz managing just 81 passing yards compared to 234 for the Bills’ Josh Allen. Wentz’s low output has been an issue for most of the season so far but Minnesota may have solved their quarterback problem after trading for Kirk Cousins. On the back of Cousins returning to the Vikings, Wilson, when speaking about his favourite for the Super Bowl, said that the Vikings ‘just got a few more wins’ after adding the 38-year-old to their roster. Speaking on ‘Set, Hut!’ , the ex-NFL player said: “Credit to the Minnesota Vikings. And these guys, Minnesota Vikings may be my new favourite, for the Super Bowl and getting coming out of the NFC. You got the 49ers, right? Obviously, those guys have been really good all year, watching the Packers and how they’re starting to heat up in this division and everything else. “But now you look at this division: the Minnesota Vikings, right? They just got a few more wins with Kirk Cousins.” Cousins currently has 2,340 passing yards this season, which is the fifth-most in the league. By comparison, Wentz has just 357 yards and the second-lowest completion rate in the NFL (48.4%). item.title: Exeter's Cummins 'fully deserves' Ireland U21 call-up
item.description: Charlie Cummins' goal ensured a memorable FA Cup win at Huddersfield Town on Saturday [Shutterstock] Exeter City manager Matt Taylor says midfielder Charlie Cummins deserves his call-up to the Republic of Ireland's under-21 side. The 21-year-old has been in impressive form this season, scoring three times including the winner in Exeter's 2-1 FA Cup first-round victory at League One leaders Huddersfield Town on Saturday. Cummins has progressed through Exeter's academy system since moving to St James park in January 2024 from Cobh Ramblers for an undisclosed fee. He has been a mainstay of the side this season having started all 14 of Exeter's League Two fixtures. "It's fully deserved. Not just his performances but the way he's conducted himself and he's playing a man's game in a really serious level of football," Taylor told BBC Radio Devon. "So when he goes to under-21s level with Ireland I hope he continues that and looks like he has done. "His goals recently have been an added bonus, but his performances are going from strength to strength. "He fully deserves it, it's great for his family, fantastic for the football club and the academy again, another young player who's now into that international bracket as well as just being a first-team player." Exeter's young squad hailed after memorable FA Cup win Huddersfield Town 1-2 Exeter City Cummins' call-up for the UEFA European Under-21 Championship play-offs against Finland came as a replacement for an injured player. As such it was only announced on Monday and came after the cut-off for Exeter to get Saturday's game with Cheltenham Town postponed. The Grecians also have Kenya's Vincent Harper and Scotland Under-21 player Ethan Sutherland away on international duty. "Two days earlier then the game gets called off if we want it to," added Taylor. "You don't want any game of football called off, I'm not in that mindset whatsoever. "But you also, selfishly as a manager, want your best players available at all times. "You're torn really, but then the administrators and the people who produce a schedule or work to a schedule say if too many games are called off then there's too much to fit in at the back end of the season. "We've not hit the winter months where games might be called off due to the weather or further cup runs. "I've not got the answers, we just feel a little bit hard done by going into this weekend. "But no excuses from me, no excuses from the team. If one player is not available, like some of our players weren't available last weekend, it's an opportunity to see the strength and depth that we've got." item.title: Zamfara: Jaji wins APC rerun primary by 26,646 votes
item.description: By Idris Salisu, Gusau A member representing Kaura-Namoda/Birnin Magaji Federal Constituency in the House of Representatives, Hon. Aminu Sani Jaji, has won the All Progressives Congress (APC) fresh primary election for the constituency with a landslide victory. Jaji emerged winner of the rerun primary conducted on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, polling 26,646 votes to defeat his closest challenger, Hassan Umar Dangaladima, who scored 713 votes. The third aspirant, Musa Zubairu, polled no votes. The Chairman of the APC Electoral Committee for the Kaura-Namoda/Birnin Magaji fresh primary, Hon. Kabiru Idris, announced the results at the constituency’s collation centre in Kaura-Namoda. Giving a breakdown of the exercise, Idris said the constituency had 42,266 registered party members, out of whom 27,389 were accredited to vote, while 27,359 votes were cast. In the results announced, Jaji scored 14,264 votes in Kaura-Namoda Local Government Area, against Dangaladima’s 465 votes, while Zubairu scored zero. In Birnin Magaji Local Government Area, Jaji polled 12,382 votes, while Dangaladima secured 248 votes. Zubairu again scored zero. Declaring the result, Idris said Jaji had satisfied the requirements of the law, the APC constitution and the party’s guidelines, and was therefore returned as the winner of the fresh primary. The rerun followed a suit filed by Dangaladima at the Federal High Court, Abuja, which nullified Jaji’s earlier nomination and ordered the party to conduct a fresh primary within two weeks. The APC national leadership subsequently fixed November 11, 2026, for the rerun, in compliance with the court’s order. The post Zamfara: Jaji wins APC rerun primary by 26,646 votes appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Patriots News: Pats let trade deadline pass, move on to Lions
item.description: FOXBOROUGH, MA - OCTOBER 11: Caleb Lomu #74 of the New England Patriots during a game between the New England Patriots and the Las Vegas Raiders on October 11, 2026, at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts. (Photo by Fred Kfoury III/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images The Patriots front office let the trade deadline pass without making any moves. There were a number of reasons for this, the best being that the price of the players being offered was too high. Eliot Wolf and crew were right in guarding the team’s draft assets. I get that it’s disappointing to see contenders acquiring players to support their playoff runs. It’s similar to when fans would watch the Pats trade out of the first round at the Draft, watching all the players they’ve become attached to find homes in other cities. But that’s what bad front offices do – make trades just to make a splash, give the impression that they’re dynamic, and then pay the price next year when they’re trying to build a roster with significantly less capital. These discussions and debates continue to make the NFL world go round. Plenty of links below to get you ready to dive into Week 10 – or feel like you’re in a barrel heading for the Falls. Enjoy! Hector Longo is concerned about whether RB Corey Kiner can carry the load for the Patriots’ offense. item.title: Transfer targets, in-house fixes for Mauricio Pochettino at Manchester United: Who fits, who doesn't?
item.description: Mauricio Pochettino's possible/probable/impending move to Manchester United — Michael Carrick is still in charge at the moment! — could see limited changes to the team until January. That might sound wild given United's massive struggles this season, but Pochettino like Carrick favors a 4-2-3-1 and the cupboard is relatively bare at Old Trafford despite the club's annual spending spree. MORE — Pochettino ‘perfect fit’ for Man United Pochettino has limited experience with current Manchester United players, almost zero in recent history. A teenage Luke Shaw was a mainstay for Pochettino at Southampton in 2013-14, while an also-teenage Andrey Santos had a preseason with Pochettino before going on loan to Nottingham Forest and then Strasbourg. Mason Mount left Chelsea for Man United much to Pochettino's chagrin during the manager's first summer on the blue side of London. So while the formation would be familiar, Day One would be a fresh start for almost everyone including the finally-returning Shaw. Which current Man United stars could shine under Mauricio Pochettino? Bruno Fernandes would seemingly endorse Pochettino's pressing plans and thrive in them. Jokes aside , the Portuguese veteran would be a must-use asset and must-solve problem for Pochettino in the interim. Kobbie Mainoo, Amad Diallo, Bryan Mbeumo, and Matheus Cunha fit almost anyone's pressing system but those are all components in a team which has failed to thrive under Carrick. Benjamin Sesko could also do well when he returns in a few months. The back line is more complicated. Ball-playing center back Matthijs de Ligt could be a fit as a leader and ball mover but needs a partner with significant recovery speed. Harry Maguire is not that man. In fact, the first Man United defender to hit the “top speed” leaderboard amongst centerbacks this season is all the way down at No. 33 with Leny Yoro, a step quicker than not-quick Maguire (No. 44). Ayden Heaven is at 64 and Lisandro Martinez 73. Shaw ranks well for speed amongst PL fullbacks , though like De Ligt his injury history is a concern. An interesting one for Pochettino is Marcus Rashford. The manager has praised the player over the years but Rashford's pressing acumen is questionable. Who could be Manchester United’s transfer targets in January? (Photo by Omar Vega/Getty Images) Getty Images There will be some links with United States men's national team players for sure. Pochettino could absolutely try to pry Tyler Adams from Bournemouth. His USMNT captain is one of the best pressers in the Premier League and might fancy a move to the Champions League if things turn around over the next month. item.title: Top four teams in Fifa rankings set to be kept apart until semi-finals at 2027 Women’s World Cup
item.description: Team must win World Cup group to trigger rule Spain, US, Germany and England currently in top four The top four-ranked teams will be separated until the semi-finals at the 2027 Women’s World Cup, provided they each win their group, after a change to the tournament’s draw procedure was confirmed by Fifa. Spain, the United States, Germany and England are currently ranked one to four in the world respectively, although the US and England still need to qualify for the tournament. The seedings will be based on 7 December’s updated rankings, meaning the standings could change before the draw, which will take place on 11 December in Rio de Janeiro. Continue reading...

item.title: Yankees working through very important internal issue
item.description: LAS VEGAS — Yankees owner Hal Steinbrenner blamed the hitters for his club not winning the AL East and losing in the second round of the playoffs. Even though three-time MVP right fielder Aaron Judge was hurt for more than half the season and former MVP Giancarlo Stanton played only 24 games, it appears hitting coach James Rowson will be a scapegoat. “We’re still working through our hitting coach situation,” GM Brian Cashman said Tuesday at MLB’s General Managers Meetings . Cashman was asked if his statement means Rowson won’t return. “You can assume what I said earlier, which was that it’s a fluid situation, and I have nothing more to add at this time on that,” Cashman said. Then he said more: “We’re working through it. Just takes time. So first, James Rowson’s a free agent. He’s talking to other clubs at the same time and we’re also engaged in the marketplace and also internally, determining what’s next and best for us. “It’s not resolved yet, so I really don’t have any more to add. But that’s the current status of that.” Rowson has been the Yankees’ hitting coach the last three seasons, this year assisted by Casey Dykes and Jake Hirst. All three hitting coaches are in limbo. The Yankees also may need a new bench coach because Brad Ausmus is a frontrunner for the Astros’ open manager position. If Ausmus leaves, the Yankees could bring back Carlos Mendoza, who was Aaron Boone’s bench coach from 2020-22. Mendoza, who was fired as the Mets ’ manager last June, was in the Yankees’ organization from 2009-22, the last five seasons in the majors. He recently joined the Phillies as their third-base coach. The Yankees already have one new coach. Aaron Gershenfeld has been promoted from the minor leagues to replace director of catching Tanner Swanson, who left the organization to be the Seattle Mariners bench coach. “Tanner left,” Cashman said. “He did a great job for us and he’s always had interest in being a bench coach, and maybe even a future manager one day, I think that’s one of the reasons why you saw him as the WBC bench coach for Great Britain (last spring), obviously trying to increase his profile. He’s an exceptional baseball mind, and he did a great job while he was with us, and now obviously Seattle saw those options in him, and so he’s in Seattle’s space now and pursuing his dreams. “We elevated Aaron Gershenfeld to our Major League field coordinator and catching coach as well. He’s been patient, waiting in the wings for an opportunity that didn’t occur until that vacancy happened.” Five other members of Boone’s staff are returning: Pitching coach Matt Blake, assistant pitching coaches Preston Claiborne and Desi Drushel, first base/baserunning coach Dan Fiorito and third base/outfield coach Luis Rojas. “Everything else is to be determined,” Cashman said. Including hitting coach. “I’m working through thoughts and permutations and have had discussions about what’s best and what’s next,” Cashman said. “I’ll just leave it at that.” Read the ori

item.title: Texas Longhorns AD Chris Del Conte shoots down reported speculation about Big 12 job
item.description: Texas Longhorns Athletic Director Chris Del Conte looks at a replay during the game against the Mississippi Rebelsin the second half at Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium in Austin on Saturday Oct. 24, 2026. (Jay Janner/Austin American-Statesman) The Big 12 needs a new commissioner, but Texas Longhorns athletic director Chris Del Conte insists that it won't be him. On Wednesday, Del Conte said that he wasn't interested in leading the Big 12 Conference. According to On Texas Football, there was speculation that the Big 12 wanted to court either Del Conte or American Conference leader Tim Pernetti as its next commissioner. "Absolutely none," Del Conte told On Texas Football when asked if he had interest in the job. Del Conte then told the publication to "print that." Rumor that the Big 12 is courting Chris Del Conte or Tim Pernetti as its next commissioner. Was told this morning CDC has no interest in that job. "Absolutely none," CDC said. "Print that." #HookEm - Bobby Burton (@BobbyBurtonOTF) November 11, 2026 The Big 12 will soon need to replace Brett Yormark, who is stepping away after nearly five years on the job. Texas was in the Big 12 when Yormark was hired. Del Conte has been at Texas since December 2017. Under his watch, the Longhorns have won five Directors' Cup , claimed 18 national championships, made a slew of successful coaching hires and smoothly transitioned into life in the SEC. Before Texas, the 58-year-old Del Conte led the athletic departments at TCU and Rice. Due to a contract extension that Del Conte signed in 2025, he is set to make $3 million during the 2026-27 fiscal year . He is guaranteed a raise during every year of a contact that ends in 2036. This article originally published at Texas Longhorns AD Chris Del Conte shoots down reported speculation about Big 12 job .

item.title: Pochettino ready to accept Man Utd offer to replace Carrick
item.description: Michael Carrick is set to depart as Manchester United manager, with Mauricio Pochettino in talks to replace him [Getty Images] Mauricio Pochettino is ready to accept an offer from Manchester United to become their next head coach. United have opened talks with the Argentine about him potentially replacing Michael Carrick, who is expected to be relieved of his duties in the next 48 hours. Once Carrick's future is clarified, sources have told BBC Sport that USA manager Pochettino wants to take the job. US Soccer officials are expecting an official approach from United - and sources have told BBC Sport they have a contingency plan for their manager leaving, which includes a succession plan. Former Tottenham and Chelsea boss Pochettino wants to remain respectful to the US Soccer Federation and will wait for United to make their approach. The Red Devils would be required to pay $10m (£7.5m) to release Pochettino from his contract, which he only signed in August. The USA have a two-legged Concacaf Nations League quarter-final against Haiti over the next week. With confidence over a succession plan, it raises the possibility that Pochettino may not take charge of those games. On Thursday, US Soccer cancelled planned media with players citing a clash with Veterans Day, though some reports claimed it was to stop the squad being asked about their manager. Pochettino, 54, is understood to view the prospect of managing United as a serious opportunity, with the expectation being he would accept the job were it formally offered. United have spoken to the ex-Argentina defender about their managerial position on three previous occasions - when Jose Mourinho was sacked in 2018, then in 2022 before the club appointed Erik ten Hag and again when the Dutchman was sacked in 2024. Carrick's future at United will be decided at a meeting in Monaco on Wednesday that will be attended by chief executive Omar Berrada, director of football Jason Wilcox and co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe. Berrada and Wilcox have flown to Monaco for one of their regular, planned meetings to discuss strategy around the football club. On this occasion, the main issue to be decided is Carrick's future and what should happen next. It is expected that Berrada and Wilcox's recommendation is for the head coach to go. Carrick, 45, was pictured arriving at the club's Carrington training base on Wednesday. United are 18th in the Premier League - inside the relegation zone - after winning just one of their first 10 games and none since August. It is the club's lowest position at this stage of a top-flight season since 1986-87, when they were 20th. Pochettino's first job in the Premier League was at Southampton from January 2013, before a five-year stint at Tottenham from 2014 that included a Champions League final appearance. item.content:encoded: Michael Carrick is set to depart as Manchester United manager, with Mauricio Pochettino in talks to replace him [Getty Images] Mauricio Pochettino is ready to accept an offer from Manchester United to become their next head coach. Once Carrick's future is clarified, sources have told BBC Sport that USA manager Pochettino wants to take the job. Former Tottenham and Chelsea boss Pochettino wants to remain respectful to the US Soccer Federation and will wait for United to make their approach. The Red Devils would be required to pay $10m (£7.5m) to release Pochettino from his contract, which he only signed in August. The USA have a two-legged Concacaf Nations League quarter-final against Haiti over the next week. With confidence over a succession plan, it raises the possibility that Pochettino may not take charge of those games. On Thursday, US Soccer cancelled planned media with players citing a clash with Veterans Day, though some reports claimed it was to stop the squad being asked about their manager. Pochettino, 54, is understood to view the prospect of managing United as a serious opportunity, with the expectation being he would accept the job were it formally offered. United have spoken to the ex-Argentina defender about their managerial position on three previous occasions - when Jose Mourinho was sacked in 2018, then in 2022 before the club appointed Erik ten Hag and again when the Dutchman was sacked in 2024. Carrick's future at United will be decided at a meeting in Monaco on Wednesday that will be attended by chief executive Omar Berrada, director of football Jason Wilcox and co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe. Berrada and Wilcox have flown to Monaco for one of their regular, planned meetings to discuss strategy around the football club. On this occasion, the main issue to be decided is Carrick's future and what should happen next. It is expected that Berrada and Wilcox's recommendation is for the head coach to go. Carrick, 45, was pictured arriving at the club's Carrington training base on Wednesday. United are 18th in the Premier League - inside the relegation zone - after winning just one of their first 10 games and none since August. It is the club's lowest position at this stage of a top-flight season since 1986-87, when they were 20th. Pochettino's first job in the Premier League was at Southampton from January 2013, before a five-year stint at Tottenham from 2014 that included a Champions League final appearance. He managed Paris St-Germain from January 2021 to July 2022 before spending the 2023-24 season in charge of Chelsea. Pochettino moved into international football by taking the USA job in September 2024, and led the co-hosts to the last 16 of the 2026 World Cup. Analysis: More clarity on Carrick future expected today While it may seem a touch immoral for Manchester United to be talking to a potential new manager before they have decided if their current one is staying or not, this kind of situation is not uncommon in football. Jose Mourinho had agreed a contract with United in 2016 before Louis van Gaal was sacked, which is how stories - including from BBC Sport - came out that the Dutchman would be dismissed as he was celebrating the FA Cup final triumph over Crystal Palace. Going further back, Mark Hughes was replaced immediately by Roberto Mancini at Manchester City in 2009. Hughes' imminent dismissal was reported on the morning of his final game in charge. It is impossible to reach that situation without talks taking place beforehand, and it would be naive to think they do not go on in a world in which agents are pushing clients for jobs that either do, or do not, exist or clubs are trying to gauge interest before making a decision. I have been told by one source the Pochettino terms to join United are more or less agreed. I have also been told if they decide to push on, United can decide whether the former Spurs and Chelsea boss remains with the USA team for their matches against Haiti. If he did stay, it would mean a sharp turnaround from a Tuesday night match - which finishes in the early hours of Wednesday - to be at Carrington for preparations before United's game against Liverpool at Anfield on 22 November. There are a lot of gaps to fill in yet, not least whether Carrick will be dismissed or not. But it seems more likely there will be clarity on that on Wednesday, and from that the rest of the jigsaw pieces should start to slot into place. Would Pochettino be the right appointment to replace Carrick? Have your say The Monaco summit that will decide the future of Carrick and Man Utd Pochettino, Howe, Emery... or Carrick? item.title: Former Cincinnati Reds closer Emilio Pagán signs with Detroit Tigers
item.description: CINCINNATI, OHIO - AUGUST 19: Emilio Pagan #15 of the Cincinnati Reds pitches during the ninth inning against the St. Louis Cardinals at Great American Ball Park on August 19, 2026 in Cincinnati, Ohio. Cincinnati defeated St. Louis 5-4. (Photo by Kirk Irwin/Getty Images) | Getty Images There was consistently a positive relationship between Cincinnati Reds closer Emilio Pagán and manager Terry Francona during their three-year run in the Queen City. The future Hall of Fame manager trusted Pagán with the closer’s job early in 2025 with Alexis Diaz fell completely apart, and the move paid off in spades both for the Reds and Pagán, who turned his 2025 success into a new 2-year, $20 million contract after the Reds made the playoffs. That deal, though, included an opt-out at the end of the 2026 season, an opt-out that Pagán exercised just days after the Milwaukee Brewers won the World Series. In the wake of that decision, Tito clearly maintained contact with his former closer, even revealing to MLB.com’s Mark Sheldon last week that he’d recently been texting him . I texted him last night and he was at dinner. I said, “Do I need to come over there and kick your [butt]?” The reason I said that is I love the guy. He’s such a phenomenal teammate. He bailed us out. When we made him the closer, it allows you to work from back to front, when you know there’s an end in sight. I’m not giving up on him coming back. He has the right to test the market. But I don’t think it’s any secret how much I enjoyed him and how much I respect him and how much I love him. Just a week after turning down the chance to pitch for the Reds again at a $10 million rate, Pagán agreed to an $11 million deal to pitch for the Detroit Tigers for the 2027 season. Tigers signing top reliever Emilio Pagán. About $11M, 1 year , via sources — Jon Heyman (@JonHeyman) November 11, 2026 I am not one to put words into another person’s mouth. I will merely point out that it’s a little bit curious that Pagán opted out in a ‘bet on yourself after a couple good years’ kind of move and ended up signing elsewhere at almost exactly the same rate that was already guaranteed to you from an organization that, per Francona, still had a lot of love for you – all after testing the market for roughly one whole week. There are a million different ways to interpret this, quite literally. The Reds sure do look like a mis-managed sinking ship, and for Pagán to recognize that while having an opportunity to bail deserves neither fault nor scorn. Frankly, I wouldn’t blame him one single bit if that was all he was looking to do. Detroit’s home park offers a fly-ball pitcher like him a whole lot more room to succeed with his own methods than do the cozy confines of Great American Ball Park. Perhaps he simply wanted to get a guarantee on the books before the looming December 1st lockout, and did so with a team in whom he has more confidence than he has in the Reds. Cincinnati did change pitching coaches from Derek Johnso

Tigers signing top reliever Emilio Pagán. About $11M, 1 year , via sources — Jon Heyman (@JonHeyman) November 11, 2026 I am not one to put words into another person’s mouth. I will merely point out that it’s a little bit curious that Pagán opted out in a ‘bet on yourself after a couple good years’ kind of move and ended up signing elsewhere at almost exactly the same rate that was already guaranteed to you from an organization that, per Francona, still had a lot of love for you – all after testing the market for roughly one whole week.
